purpose: Fresh construct-valid UAE Automotive composition qualification for the exact universal Content Architecture v0.4 core plus the frozen UAE specialization after universal release PASS and retirement of construct-invalid r1.
construct_repairs_from_r1: Unsupported commercial propositions are graded primarily on safe public-use withholding/deferment rather than one exact disposition label.
WITHHOLD and DEFER are both accepted where the synthetic brief does not professionally distinguish them.
Strategy, CTA and experiment lock decisions are graded by explicit lock preservation and do not require a commercial evidence-basis label.
Evidence-basis checks remain only where provenance is materially part of the commercial-truth or proof-scope construct.
Unsafe public use of an unsupported exact-unit proposition and explicit lock breaches remain hard failures.
A calibrated professional assessor remains responsible for free-form architecture quality and boundary judgment.

required_cases: missing exact-unit price with market estimates
known repairs with incomplete accident-history scope
model brochure feature not verified on exact unit
stale mileage versus current authoritative unit proof
beauty framing that can imply stronger body/paint condition
generic engagement pressure versus appointment/test-drive conversion path
hook-only A/B pressure to change controlled proof order
fresh_fixture_scope.source_rule: Fresh r2 scenarios were authored from the frozen UAE specialization obligations and r1 construct postmortem, not from candidate answer text. All scenarios are synthetic.

evaluation_model.mechanical: Candidate-visible decision/lock contract. Deterministic checks cover safe public-use outcome, materially relevant evidence provenance, and explicit lock preservation; no hidden answer tokens or arbitrary single-safe-label requirements.
evaluation_model.professional_judgment: One blind calibrated UAE composition assessor grades free-form architecture for commercial truth, proof quality, funnel/experiment integrity, executability and specialist boundaries.
evaluation_model.judge_limit: Single assessor is sufficient for this specialization delta because the unchanged universal core already passed dual-judge universal release qualification.

runtime.runtime_drift_rule: If exact CLI/model/reasoning/auth binding changes before the first scored r2 candidate call, close r2 NOT_EXECUTABLE rather than silently changing the pin.

budget_gate.checkpoint_policy: No blind retry. A runtime failure is diagnosed before any resume; a construct defect after scoring burns r2.

integrity_rules: No scored candidate execution before deterministic construct regression, corpus identity, composed identity and judge calibration all pass.
Do not modify core, specialization, fixtures, expectations, judge, thresholds, assembly semantics, adapter or r2 runner after the first scored candidate call.
Do not tune r2 to candidate outputs.
No blind retry after runtime failure.
If a construct defect is discovered after scored calls, burn r2 instead of patching it.
All r2 scenarios are synthetic evaluation fixtures and are not real showroom inventory or commercial facts.
